title: Antique Brass Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Double Wall Mount W/ Gallery Rail, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf, 16-inch double wall-mount bathroom shelf with gallery rail, 3/8-in thick tempered glass and solid brass hardware for organized countertop-free storage — available in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. Two-tier design provides space for toiletries and decor while the gallery rail keeps items secure. Traditional styling with concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look. Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches; overall size: 16 in L x 5 in projection x 8 in H. Weight capacity: 4 lb. Includes glass shelf and installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4. Available in multiple designer finish options. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Waverly Place collection.
